task: The streaming service's recommendations team wants to train a model on what members have rated, but the ratings export is a raw event log with repeats and changed opinions. Build a pipeline that cleans the interactions, describes every member and film with a few features, and splits the data by time so the features never see the months the model will be tested on, with a summary that proves the split is clean.
skills: latest row per key with a window
left joins that keep cold starts
problems: Rating rows delivered twice by the export (exact copies).
Re-ratings: the same member rates the same film again later with a new value.
Members with an account but no ratings at all, and films nobody has rated.
Some re-ratings cross the cutoff: the first rating is in the training months, the new one after them.
revenue: A member's opinion of a film is their latest rating of it; if two ratings share the same moment, the higher one counts. The model trains on ratings made before 1 July 2026 and is tested on ratings from that moment on. Features describe the training months only, so a member or film first seen after the cutoff is a cold start.
